verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Go SDK's RenewWithContext method for renewing an expiring domain, so an admin could script renewals but would have to build their own scheduling around it. Nothing in the pack documents per-domain auto-renew toggles, expiry notifications, or grace and redemption periods. Missing for 10: per-domain auto-renew controls, expiry notice emails/alerts, documented grace and redemption windows and fees, independent corroboration.
